items.title: OpenAI lets safety evaluators inside, with strings attached
items.summary: Models: Apollo Research, METR, Transluce and Goodfire get "deep access" to internal models. But OpenAI can withhold information, limit staff access, keep evaluators off Slack, and censor reports for confidential details. Conclusions must still be published unchanged.
